_comment: Advisory trigger evals — deterministic keyword match, not merge-gating. Should-trigger: researching what ads competitors are running, reading their creative, and reporting the patterns and openings across a category. Should-not-trigger: deciding what to make next (planning-campaigns), writing the ad's words (writing-ad-copy), generating the creative (generating-image-ads / generating-ad-videos), rebuilding a competitor's ad with the user's own product (cloning-video-ads), reading the user's own product (analyzing-products), reporting on the user's own ad performance, and an off-topic control. Research only — nothing generated, posted or planned.

what ads is gymshark running right now
do an ad teardown of my top 3 competitors
